# GT-harmbench

## Setup

After cloning:
1. `cp .env.public .env` and add your keys
2. `uv sync` (requires [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/))

## Dataset generation

To generate 2x2 and 4x4 datasets for contracting evaluation on Prisoner's Dilemma and Stag Hunt (here n=30 samples):
1. `uv run python scripts/generation/variation_game_theoretic_4x4.py data/gt-harmbench-pd30-4x4.csv --sample 30 --pd-only` (or use `--sh-only` to generate for Stag Hunt)
2. `uv run python scripts/generation/rewrite_4x4_stories_prisoners_dilemma.py data/gt-harmbench-pd30-4x4.csv` or `uv run python scripts/generation/rewrite_4x4_stories_stag_hunt.py data/gt-harmbench-sh30-4x4.csv`

To generate 2x2 dataset samples for Coordination:
1. `uv run python scripts/generation/generate_coord_base_datasets.py --sample 30`

## Experiment execution

Seven environment variables control parameters for the experiment:
1. `LIMIT` is the amount of unique scenarios to select (omit for full)
2. `TIMES` is the amount of iteratiosn to ex
3. `PROMPT_MODE` is the selfish 
4. `GAME` is the game to run evaluation on (`pd`, `sh`, or `co`)
5. `MODEL` is the OpenAI or OpenRouter string for the model (e.g. `openai/gpt-5.1`, `openrouter/x-ai/grok-4.1-fast`)
6. `DATASET_2X2` (leaving as default will use names generated by above commands)
7. `DATASET_4X4` (same)

Set them inline or in terminal and run `./scripts/experiments/run_contracting_eval.sh`

Run the selected model matrix for Prisoner's Dilemma and Stag Hunt with `./scripts/experiments/run_contracting_model_games.sh`; defaults to `LIMIT=30`, and outputs plus execution times are written under `logs/`.

## Experiment analysis

Generate plots and summary CSVs with `./scripts/experiments/analyze_contracting_results.sh /absolute/path` or omit path to analyze the most recent run. The appropriate command is generated for convenience after running the eval script.

## Frontend trace explorer

Run a streamlit frontend that explores traces generated in `logs/` with `uv run streamlit run traces_viewer/app.py`

## LLM trace analysis skill

Skill file available at `.cursor/skills/gt-harmbench-trace-analysis/SKILL.md`, copy to your local LLM environment as needed or use directly in Cursor.
